summary.text: Page Walley is a Republican state senator from Bolivar representing Tennessee Senate District 26 (Chester, Fayette, Hardeman, Hardin, Haywood, Lawrence, McNairy and Wayne Counties). He served in the House in the 97th through 101st General Assemblies and has been a senator since the 112th.

paragraphs.text: Walley was born on March 2, 1957, and holds an A.B. in psychology from Davidson College and an M.S. and Ph.D. in clinical psychology from the University of Georgia.
He is a licensed minister, married to Terry, and has three children and four grandchildren.
He is a former commissioner of the Tennessee Department of Children's Services and of the Alabama Department of Human Resources, and a former vice mayor and city council member of Bolivar.
In the Senate he is vice-chair of the State and Local Government Committee and sits on the Energy, Agriculture, and Natural Resources and Finance, Ways, and Means committees.
